thread:
anya: FYI console flagged negative cache savings for a few sessions. quick repro: session warmed prefetch_kv=100 on model=gpt-lite, then router fell back after 90 tokens and charged gpt-small for last 30. UI shows prefetch credit across all 120 tokens.

miguel: likely attribution gap. router emits warmup prefetch but not the token index where handoff happened. billing ends up applying full credit.

lina: minimal change: have router emit a session_handoff telemetry event with handoff_token_index + prefetch_kv. billing can join on token index.

product-sam: UX asks for a "why negative" drilldown listing handoffs and a small "est. error" badge when heuristics are used.

anya: fallback for old routers: billing uses timestamps + avg tokens/sec to estimate handoff index and marks them as estimated. console shows reconciled marker once nightly job runs.

miguel: debate: headers vs async telemetry. prefer telemetry event to keep router thin.

sre-bot: deploy-bot: rolling canary for router-prefetch-metadata -> 2/4 hosts updated :rocket:

lina: plan: router emits session_handoff event; telemetry indexes into session-attribution; billing reconciliation job allocates prefetch by token index; console shows provisional vs reconciled with drilldown.

anya: will open a tiny PR with test vectors and link to rollout doc. closing once merged.
